description.value:
Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute

Draw a quick ward in blood, ash, or ink on a nearby surface. While within 10 feet of it, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against effects created by fiends, undead, or aberrations. The ward crumbles if moved and does not travel with you.
